dropped.1: The assertion readers and the EvalTurn/EvalToolCall records moved to eval-assert; HostGenerateFn, StepUsage, StepFetch and EvalWorkflowEngineOptions left the surface (EvalWorkflowsOptions spells stepFetch/speech out).
EvalRequest.outcome is open (| (string & {})), so an exhaustive switch over the three outcomes no longer compiles.
PhoneTreeWalk.stopped is open (| (string & {})), so an exhaustive switch over hung-up/max-prompts no longer compiles.
SimulatedCall.endedBy is open (| (string & {})), so an exhaustive switch over caller/agent/max-turns no longer compiles.
createToolCallRepair takes one ToolCallRepairOptions bag instead of (model, log, getAbortSignal); SttError/TtsError.code are open; the orphaned S2sConfig is gone.
RuntimeOptions.journal takes the opaque WorkflowJournal, not a JournalStore; ExecuteTool, ExecuteToolOptions and SkipGreetingOption left the surface; RunCodeExecutor is declared here.
AgentServerOptions.journal takes the opaque WorkflowJournal, not a JournalStore.
SessionEventStream is a sealed reader (tail, read, durable); the writing half (append, flush, hydrate, discard, clear) is internal.
CarrierCodec's media/clear methods became one encode(out: CarrierOutbound); CarrierInbound's ignore variant became other { type } and gained dtmf { digit }.

The journal store and its records (JournalStore, RunRecord, StepEntry, SleepRecord, ...), JournalConflictError and DeterminismKind left testing; RunWorkflowOptions.journal takes WorkflowJournal; the handle reads waits/resumable; TextAgentTestRun.steps (ai StepResult) is gone.
TextTurnResult is a declared sealed slice (textStream, text, response, consumeStream) instead of the whole ReturnType<typeof streamText>.
The orphaned McpCallResult, McpInputSchema and McpTrust left the surface; no published signature reached them.
The orphaned UploadMeta and UploadPart left the surface; no published signature reached them.
WORKFLOW_API_PREFIX is no longer re-exported (it is the SDK's, on @alexkroman1/aai/internal).
